name: Back Squat
instructions: Set the bar on your upper back, brace, squat down under control, then drive up through midfoot.

name: Deadlift
instructions: Set the bar over midfoot, brace, push the floor away, and stand tall without leaning back.

name: Bench Press
instructions: Set your shoulder blades, lower the bar to mid-chest, then press up over the shoulders.

name: Overhead Press
instructions: Brace hard, press from shoulder height to overhead, and finish with the bar stacked over midfoot.

name: Power Clean
instructions: Pull from the floor, extend hard through the hips, then catch the bar high on the shoulders.

name: Front Squat
instructions: Hold a tall front rack, keep elbows high, squat down, then drive up without collapsing forward.

name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hold the load close, push hips back with soft knees, feel the hamstring stretch, then stand tall.

name: Pull-Up
instructions: Start from a full hang, pull chest toward the bar, then lower under control.

name: Chin-Up
instructions: Use an underhand grip, pull chin over the bar, then return to a full controlled hang.

name: Barbell Row
instructions: Hinge with a braced torso, row the bar to your lower ribs, then lower without losing position.

name: Dumbbell Row
instructions: Brace on a bench, row the dumbbell toward your hip, pause briefly, then lower under control.

name: Incline Bench Press
instructions: Set the bench on an incline, lower to upper chest, then press up without flaring hard.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie flat, lower dumbbells beside the chest, then press up and slightly together.

name: Dip
instructions: Lower until shoulders are comfortable, keep elbows tracking back, then press to locked-out arms.

name: Walking Lunge
instructions: Step forward, lower the back knee under control, then drive through the front foot into the next step.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Set rear foot on a bench, lower through the front leg, then drive up through the front foot.

name: Hip Thrust
instructions: Set upper back on a bench, tuck ribs down, drive hips up, pause, then lower under control.

name: Push-Up
instructions: Keep a straight body line, lower chest toward the floor, then press up without sagging hips.

name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Set shoulders down, pull the bar to upper chest, then control the stretch back overhead.

name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Sit tall, pull the handle toward your torso, squeeze back, then return with control.

name: Bicep Curl
instructions: Keep elbows still, curl the weight up, squeeze briefly, then lower fully under control.

name: Hammer Curl
instructions: Keep palms facing in, curl without swinging, then lower until elbows are fully extended.

name: Tricep Pushdown
instructions: Pin elbows by your sides, press the handle down, lock out, then return under control.

name: Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Keep upper arms near your head, lower into a stretch, then extend elbows fully.

name: Lateral Raise
instructions: Raise arms out to the sides with soft elbows, stop around shoulder height, then lower slowly.

name: Face Pull
instructions: Pull the rope toward eye level with elbows high, then return while keeping shoulders controlled.

name: Calf Raise
instructions: Lower into a full calf stretch, rise onto the balls of your feet, pause, then lower slowly.

name: Plank
instructions: Brace abs and glutes, keep ribs down, and hold a straight line from shoulders to heels.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
instructions: Hang tall, curl pelvis up as you raise legs, then lower without swinging.

name: Run
instructions: Use an easy warm-up, settle into the planned pace, and keep breathing and stride relaxed.

name: Row Erg
instructions: Drive with legs, swing the torso, pull to ribs, then recover arms, body, legs.

name: Air Bike
instructions: Push and pull the handles while driving the pedals, keeping cadence smooth and controlled.

name: Bike
instructions: Set the seat height, pedal smoothly, and keep effort matched to the workout target.

name: Ruck
instructions: Load the pack securely, walk tall, and keep a steady pace with relaxed shoulders.

name: Assisted Dip
instructions: Set assistance, lower under control, then press up while keeping elbows tracking back.

name: Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Stand tall, drop heels into a stretch, rise high onto toes, pause, then lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Supinated Curl
instructions: Start palms forward, keep elbows still, curl up, then lower to a full stretch.

name: Chest-Supported T-Bar Row
instructions: Press chest into the pad, row handles toward torso, squeeze, then lower fully.

name: Leg Extension
instructions: Set knees aligned with the machine, extend legs hard, pause, then lower slowly.

name: Cable Flye
instructions: Set cables wide, keep elbows soft, bring hands together in front of chest, then open under control.

name: Crunch
instructions: Curl ribs toward pelvis, squeeze abs, then lower without pulling on the neck.

name: Dumbbell Skull Crusher
instructions: Lie back, keep upper arms angled slightly back, bend elbows, then extend to finish.

name: Dumbbell Incline Press
instructions: Set an incline, lower dumbbells to upper chest, then press up under control.

name: Reverse Grip Lat Pulldown
instructions: Use an underhand grip, pull elbows down toward ribs, then control the stretch overhead.

name: Lying Leg Curl
instructions: Set knees at the machine pivot, curl heels toward glutes, pause, then lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Seated Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit tall, press dumbbells overhead, then lower to shoulder level under control.

name: Single-Arm Pulldown
instructions: Set shoulder down, pull one handle toward your ribs, then let the lat stretch under control.

name: Pec Deck
instructions: Set elbows on pads, bring arms together, squeeze chest, then open slowly.

name: Reverse Pec Deck
instructions: Set chest against pad, sweep arms back with rear delts, then return slowly.

name: Cable Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand side-on to the cable, raise one arm out to shoulder height, then lower slowly.

name: Close-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Grip just inside shoulder width, lower to lower chest, then press while keeping elbows tucked.

name: Bicycle Crunch
instructions: Rotate ribs toward the opposite knee while extending the other leg, then alternate sides smoothly.

name: Single-Arm Cable Curl
instructions: Face the cable, keep elbow still, curl one handle up, then lower fully.

name: Neutral-Grip Pulldown
instructions: Use neutral handles, pull elbows down toward ribs, then control the return overhead.

name: Single-Arm Rope Tricep Extension
instructions: Keep elbow fixed, extend one arm down and out, then return slowly.

name: Machine Seated Hip Abduction
instructions: Sit tall, drive knees apart, pause at the outside, then return under control.

name: Single-Leg Leg Extension
instructions: Align one knee with the pivot, extend fully, pause, then lower slowly.

name: Single-Leg Lying Leg Curl
instructions: Curl one heel toward the glute, pause, then lower slowly without hip lift.

name: Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold the weight at chest, squat between your knees, then drive up through midfoot.

name: Dumbbell Single-Leg Hip Thrust
instructions: Set upper back on bench, plant one foot, drive hips up, pause, then lower.

name: Leg Press
instructions: Set feet on the platform, lower until knees bend comfortably, then press without locking hard.

name: Seated Leg Curl
instructions: Set knees at the pivot, curl pad down and back, pause, then return slowly.

name: Cable Reverse Flye
instructions: Set cables across the body, sweep arms back with rear delts, then return slowly.

name: Cable Tricep Kickback
instructions: Hinge slightly, pin upper arm, extend elbow back, then return under control.

name: Machine Incline Chest Press
instructions: Set seat for upper chest, press handles up and forward, then lower under control.

name: Dumbbell Bent Over Lateral Raise
instructions: Hinge forward, raise dumbbells out wide with rear delts, then lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Floor Press
instructions: Lie on the floor, lower elbows until triceps touch, then press dumbbells up.

name: EZ Bar Curl
instructions: Grip the EZ-bar, keep elbows still, curl up, then lower to full extension.

name: Weighted Pull-Up
instructions: Secure the load, pull chest toward the bar, then lower to a controlled full hang.

name: Deficit Pendlay Row
instructions: Stand on a small deficit, pull each rep from the floor, then reset with a braced back.

name: Cable Overhead Triceps Extension
instructions: Face away from cable, keep elbows high, extend overhead, then return to a deep stretch.

name: Bayesian Cable Curl
instructions: Stand ahead of the cable, let arm reach behind you, curl up, then lower into the stretch.

name: Cable Crossover Ladder
instructions: Move through low, mid, or high cable flye paths, bringing hands together with control each rep.

name: Wide-Grip Pull-Up
instructions: Use a wide overhand grip, pull chest up, then lower to a full controlled hang.

name: Smith Machine Squat
instructions: Set feet comfortably, brace, squat under the Smith bar, then drive up through midfoot.

name: Cable Crunch
instructions: Kneel at the cable, curl ribs toward pelvis, squeeze abs, then return without sitting back.

name: Chest-Supported Machine Row
instructions: Brace chest on pad, row handles toward torso, squeeze back, then lower fully.

name: 1-Arm 45-Degree Cable Rear Delt Flye
instructions: Stand at a 45-degree angle, pull one cable across and back, then return slowly.

name: Machine Shrug
instructions: Hold handles, elevate shoulders straight up, pause, then lower to a full stretch.

name: EZ-Bar Cable Curl
instructions: Attach EZ-bar to cable, keep elbows still, curl up, then lower under constant tension.

name: Machine Preacher Curl
instructions: Set arms on pad, curl handle up, squeeze, then lower slowly without lifting elbows.

name: Machine Shoulder Press
instructions: Set seat so handles start near shoulders, press overhead, then lower under control.

name: Bottom-Half Dumbbell Flye
instructions: Lower dumbbells into the stretched half of a flye, then raise only through the lower range.

name: Lying Leg Raise
instructions: Lie flat, brace abs, raise legs without swinging, then lower without arching your back.

name: Dual-Handle Lat Pulldown
instructions: Pull both handles down toward ribs, drive elbows low, then control the overhead stretch.

name: Smith Machine Row
instructions: Hinge to the bar, row toward torso, squeeze back, then lower under control.

name: Smith Machine Static Lunge with Elevated Front Foot
instructions: Elevate front foot, lower into the lunge, then drive up through the front leg.

name: 45-Degree Hyperextension
instructions: Set hips on pad, hinge down, then extend hips until body is straight.

name: Leg Press Calf Press
instructions: Keep legs mostly straight, let heels drop, press through toes, pause, then lower slowly.

name: Machine Crunch
instructions: Set pad against chest, curl ribs toward pelvis, squeeze abs, then return slowly.

name: Lean-Back Lat Pulldown
instructions: Lean slightly back, pull bar toward upper chest, then control the stretch overhead.

name: Cable Paused Shrug-In
instructions: Hold cable handles, shrug up and slightly in, pause, then lower fully.

name: Cable Rope Hammer Curl
instructions: Hold rope ends, curl with palms facing in, squeeze, then lower fully.

name: Dumbbell Concentration Curl
instructions: Brace elbow against inner thigh, curl dumbbell up, squeeze, then lower slowly.

name: Machine Chest Press
instructions: Set handles at chest height, press forward, then lower until chest is stretched.

name: Bottom-Half Seated Cable Flye
instructions: Sit between cables, open into the stretched range, then bring hands halfway together.

name: EZ-Bar Skull Crusher
instructions: Lie back, keep upper arms steady, lower EZ-bar toward forehead, then extend elbows.

name: Triceps Pressdown (Bar)
instructions: Grip the bar, keep elbows pinned, press down to lockout, then return slowly.

name: Ab Wheel Rollout
instructions: Brace hard, roll forward only as far as you can control, then pull back with abs.

name: Hack Squat
instructions: Set shoulders under pads, squat deep with heels planted, then drive the sled up.

name: Converging Chest Press
instructions: Set handles at mid-chest, press forward and inward, then lower under control.

name: Flat Dumbbell Chest Press
instructions: Lie flat, lower dumbbells beside chest, then press up and slightly together.

name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Set shoulder blades, lower bar to mid-chest, then press up over shoulders.

name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hold bar close, push hips back with soft knees, stretch hamstrings, then stand tall.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hold dumbbells close, hinge back until hamstrings stretch, then drive hips forward.

name: Trap Bar Deadlift
instructions: Stand centered, brace, push the floor away, then stand tall with shoulders back.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
instructions: Raise dumbbells out to the sides with soft elbows, pause near shoulder height, then lower slowly.

name: Upright Row
instructions: Pull the load up close to the body with elbows leading, then lower under control.

name: Wide-Grip Upright Row
instructions: Use a wide grip, pull elbows up to lower chest height, then lower slowly.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Lie back on an incline, let arms hang, curl without swinging, then lower fully.

name: Standing Barbell Curl
instructions: Stand tall, keep elbows by sides, curl bar up, then lower to full extension.

name: Seated Cable Curl
instructions: Sit facing cable, keep elbows steady, curl handle up, then lower under tension.

name: Dumbbell Rear Delt Raise
instructions: Hinge forward, raise dumbbells out wide with rear delts, then lower slowly.

name: Cable Face Pull
instructions: Pull rope toward eyes with elbows high, squeeze rear delts, then return slowly.

name: Chest-Supported Row
instructions: Brace chest on support, row handles toward torso, then lower to a full stretch.

name: T-Bar Row
instructions: Hinge or brace into the pad, row handle toward torso, then lower under control.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Set incline bench, lower dumbbells to upper chest, then press up under control.

name: Incline Barbell Press
instructions: Set incline bench, lower bar to upper chest, then press up and back slightly.

name: Incline Smith Machine Press
instructions: Set incline bench under bar, lower to upper chest, then press along the guide path.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
instructions: Set upper back on bench, brace ribs down, drive hips up, pause, then lower.

name: Sumo Deadlift
instructions: Set a wide stance, brace, push knees out, drive through floor, and stand tall.

name: Dumbbell Lunge
instructions: Step into a lunge, lower under control, then drive through the front foot to stand.

name: Barbell Skull Crusher
instructions: Lie back, keep upper arms steady, lower bar toward forehead, then extend elbows.

name: Lying Dumbbell Triceps Extensions
instructions: Lie back, lower dumbbells beside your head, then extend elbows without moving shoulders.

name: Overhead Triceps Extension
instructions: Keep elbows high, lower weight behind head, then extend to lockout under control.

name: High Incline Shrugs
instructions: Lie chest-down on a high incline bench, shrug shoulders up, pause, then lower.

name: Barbell Shrug
instructions: Hold bar at thighs, shrug straight up, pause, then lower to a full stretch.

name: Decline Sit-Up
instructions: Set feet, curl torso up from the decline bench, then lower under control.

name: Single-Leg Dumbbell Calf Raise
instructions: Hold support, lower one heel into a stretch, raise high, pause, then lower.

name: Barbell Squat
instructions: Set bar on upper back, brace, squat under control, then drive up through midfoot.

name: Machine Row
instructions: Set chest or torso support, row handles toward ribs, squeeze, then return slowly.

name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
instructions: Brace on bench, row one dumbbell toward hip, pause, then lower fully.

name: Pendlay Row
instructions: Start bar on floor, brace, row to torso, then return bar to floor each rep.

name: Seated Smith Machine Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit tall under the Smith bar, press overhead, then lower to shoulder level.

name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit tall, press dumbbells overhead, then lower to shoulder level under control.

name: Barbell Deadlift
instructions: Set bar over midfoot, brace, push floor away, and stand tall without overextending.

name: Landmine Press
instructions: Hold bar at shoulder, brace, press up and forward, then lower to shoulder under control.

name: Behind-the-Back Cable Curl
instructions: Stand ahead of low cable, let arm stretch behind, curl up, then lower slowly.

name: Preacher Curl
instructions: Set upper arms on pad, curl up without lifting elbows, then lower slowly.

name: Triceps Pushdown
instructions: Pin elbows by sides, press handle to lockout, then return under control.
